rule:
Labels come from the tracker comparing the state right before and right after one
record, so nothing is hand-labelled:
  A  the record makes the condition true      (go to X -> "at X"; take O -> "holding O";
                                               move O -> "holding nothing")
  B  the record makes the condition false     (go to Y while at X -> "at X";
                                               take O -> "holding nothing"; move O -> "holding O")
  C  the record says nothing about it         ("holding O" while only walking around)
Only these unambiguous patterns are used. One example per pattern, round-robin over
the demos, in a fixed order (no randomness).

examples.condition: The agent is currently at fridge 1
examples.record:
> go to fridge 1
The fridge 1 is closed.

examples.condition: The agent is currently at countertop 1
examples.record:
> go to countertop 2
On the countertop 2, you see nothing.

examples.condition: The agent is currently holding pan 1
examples.record:
> go to fridge 1
The fridge 1 is closed.

examples.condition: The agent is currently holding lettuce 1
examples.record:
> take lettuce 1 from diningtable 1
You pick up the lettuce 1 from the diningtable 1.

examples.condition: The agent is currently holding nothing
examples.record:
> take egg 2 from countertop 3
You pick up the egg 2 from the countertop 3.

examples.condition: The agent is currently holding nothing
examples.record:
> move pan 1 to stoveburner 1
You move the pan 1 to the stoveburner 1.

examples.condition: The agent is currently holding lettuce 1
examples.record:
> move lettuce 1 to diningtable 1
You move the lettuce 1 to the diningtable 1.

examples.condition: The agent is currently holding egg 2
examples.record:
> go to microwave 1
The microwave 1 is closed.
